gloss: to summon; to call over; to send for

definitions.gloss: to summon, to call over, to send for
definitions.explanation: To have someone come to where you are by calling or requesting them. Implies the person summoned travels to the speaker's location.

examples.japanese: タクシーを{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる。
{田舎|いなか}から{母|はは}を{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: I sent for my mother from the countryside.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}から{専門家|せんもんか}を{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せて{意見|いけん}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: We summoned an expert from overseas and listened to their opinion.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{家族|かぞく}を{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (send for one's family)
・{医者|いしゃ}を{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (summon a doctor)
・{人|ひと}を{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (call people over)

USAGE NOTES:
Implies that the person or thing summoned travels a distance to come to the speaker's location. It is commonly used when bringing family members to live with you (e.g., from a rural hometown to the city, or from another country). The directional nuance of {寄|よ}せる (to draw near) distinguishes this from simply {呼|よ}ぶ (to call) — {呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる emphasizes the person actually coming to you.
